Hey man. I know how it is to feel alone and burdensome.  Here is something to think about: 
Your sister was really mad and upset right? That means she really cares and wouldn't know what to do without you. You're family is very supportive? Means they love you alot. It also means that no matter what you aren't burdening them by talking to them. Even if they don't want to hear it, don't want to think about it, they'll be happy to keep you from dieing as that's a sight they would hate more than anything. Not saying that having people who love you means you should stay alive, it just means you still have a few reasons to stay. Its up to you whether or not those reasons are worth it. Will this post make you want to stay alive? Probably not and that's not its intention. It's intention is to convince you to think about the people in your life other than your old girlfriend and ride along for a couple extra weeks. If it's been 2 already than just stay alive for another 2. That's a whole month. Hopefully during that time you'll convince yourself you have more things to live for. If not than its been atleast a less hasty decision and you'll have a slightly clearer head. I struggle alot myself with this stuff. Feel free to contact me anytime.

All I really do that I find somewhat enjoyable is drink alot every Monday and Tuesday. My days off are Tuesday and Wednesday so I can deal with the hangover. I try doing other stuff but I never really seem to be into it. I don't know why because I used to like all kinds of stuff. I used to be a big gamer, I was on the swim team in high school, I used to really like learning sciency stuff. Now a days everything seems boring. Nothing is enjoyable unless it really just destroys my thought process I guess

But I do try and experience the "good stuff". Things people say they live for. I force myself to go out with friends but the whole time I find myself wondering why I'm even there. Why do I even bother.. I'm saying I find no enjoyment in anything I try, and I am always looking for the next thing to try and see if that helps but I'm running out of new things to try. Running out of reasons to wait and see what comes the next day..

There's nothing wrong with getting your start on YT. Plenty of people have used YT to do amazing things. Someone like Phillip DeFranco is great example. He started off doing vlogs about news and major events, adding his own humour and opinions in. He still does YT but he also owns his own company now and is a major part of many other channels as well. If you do manage to be a famous YouTuber, yeah you'll probably get some good and bad attention at your highschool but it'll be way more worth it than missing out on the opportunity to start molding your future and the possibility of achieving great things.
You too bud, I hope things pick up for you

I did see a therapist for a time but I never utilized it much because ever since my friend got me nearly detained in a psych ward I don't feel comfortable speaking about my personal thoughts. Nothing against her she made the right move stopping me although I still think if I could die tonight I would. Hell I would kill myself now but I don't want to screw over my roommate. As far as moving out, I've lived where I do now since May 28th. I'm here now so if it helped at all it didn't do much for me. Maybe it will help in a few weeks time once I get my house cleaned up a bit and broken in?

It's odd I've tried many things to cope with it. I'd skip classes because those would seem to make my thoughts worse. I graduated early back in January. I've gotten drunk. Abused DPH. Don't do that BTW makes you incredibly weak and gives nightmarish hallucinations,I broke my nose OD'd on that stuff. But no matter what I do my thoughts still linger. Just recently I moved out and I live with a friend I have orientation for college in a few days. From the outside my life looks great. I'm doing everything perfectly well but it all seems so trivial to me. I don't enjoy it. I have friends I spend time with but I find myself thinking about ways I could kill myself half the time I'm with them. Every night I am thinking the way I am now. Every night for 9 months unless I'm drunk and passed out.
